Have you ever been asked which destinations you go back to every summer? London, Istanbul, Georgia… all wonderful, but there is one destination that has risen strongly in recent years and has quietly begun to steal the hearts of Gulf tourists. Kazakhstan.

– the largest Muslim country in the world by area, and one of the most surprising destinations for first-time visitors. High mountains, turquoise lakes, modern cities and summer weather that offers relief from the Gulf heat. It makes you wonder why we didn’t discover it long ago!


Why are Gulf travellers heading to Kazakhstan?

The numbers speak for themselves: more than 100 thousand Gulf tourists visited Kazakhstan between 2022 and 2024, with the UAE in first place at 32,000 visitors, followed by Oman and Saudi Arabia. This is no coincidence: there are real reasons drawing Gulf travellers to this destination.

First: ideal summer weather
While temperatures in the Gulf reach 45 degrees, in Almaty and Astana they range between 20 and 28 degrees in summer. Fresh air, greenery everywhere and mild evenings that invite you to stroll the streets.

Second: easy access
From the UAE alone, there are between 84 and 245 weekly flights to Kazakhstan depending on the season, operated by airlines such as Air Astana, flydubai and Air Arabia. The flight takes no more than 4.5 hours from Dubai, far shorter than a flight to London. Flights are also available from Riyadh, Kuwait and Muscat.

Third: a Muslim country where you feel at ease
Kazakhstan has a Muslim-majority population: you will find halal restaurants everywhere, mosques are widespread and the people are friendly and welcoming. You will not feel like a stranger.


Top destinations in Kazakhstan

🏙️ Almaty, the heart of cultural life
The largest and most vibrant city in Kazakhstan, combining modern skyscrapers with old traditional markets. From here, your trips into the enchanting countryside begin.

  • Big Almaty Lake: A turquoise mountain lake at an altitude of 2500 metres, a truly incredible sight.
  • Shymbulak Ski Resort: Even in summer, it is a great place for walking, cable-car rides and mountain views.
  • Green Bazaar (oriental produce market): A feast for the senses: spices, dried fruit and local produce.

🏛️ Astana, the city of the future
The modern capital will surprise you with its distinctive architecture, from huge glass towers to one-of-a-kind buildings designed by world-class architects. A city that looks as if it came straight out of a science-fiction film.

  • Khan Shatyr: A huge entertainment centre in the shape of a giant tent, with an artificial beach, amusement rides and shops inside.
  • Bayterek Tower: The icon of Astana: go up to the top for a 360-degree view of the city.

🏔️ Natural areas

  • Aktau and the Caspian Sea: Quiet beaches and resorts on the world's largest salt lake.
  • Karkaraly forests: Stunning scenery that is perfect for camping and horse riding.

Ready to discover Kazakhstan?

Kazakhstan is not just a destination; it is an experience unlike any other. Unspoilt nature, ancient history, modern cities and hospitable people, all at prices to suit every budget.
